variants.user_notes: Programming through the USB bootloader needs the board in its bootloader (DFU) mode; on many boards, hold its button while plugging it in.

source.ref: The maker's reply to the Open Logix project, 2026-11-08: 12 MHz external clock on pin 35.
The maker's replies to the Open Logix project, 2026-11-08: RGB LED red on 39, green on 40, blue on 41, active low (as pins 39-41, the iCE40 UltraPlus's open-drain RGB outputs, require).

ai_hints: Wired to the FPGA's RGB LED driver pads: red RGB0, green RGB1, blue RGB2.
Drive it through SB_RGBA_DRV, the iCE40 UltraPlus's RGB LED driver cell (sink only).
